raw_segments.text: Camillo, I know not, but I am sure tea's safer to avoid what's grown than question
If therefore you dare trust my honesty, that lies enclosed in this trunk, which you shall
bear along and pond away tonight.
Your followers I will whisper to the business, and will by twos and threes at several posterns
For myself, I'll put my fortunes to your service, which are here by this discovery
Be not uncertain, for, by the honor of my parents, I have uttered truth, which if you
seek to prove, I dare not stand by, nor shall you be safer than one condemned by the king's
own mouth, thereon his execution sworn.
